name: CommonsenseQA: Question Answering Targeting Commonsense Knowledge
description: CommonsenseQA is a multiple-choice question answering challenge dataset designed to evaluate commonsense reasoning capabilities. Sourced from ConceptNet subgraphs and crowd-authored by human annotators, it features 12,102 five-choice questions testing diverse semantic relations and conceptual commonsense facts.

verification.notes: Verified against NAACL 2019 publication (DOI: 10.18653/v1/N19-1421) and official TAU NLP portal. 12,102 questions partitioned across official random split: 9,741 train, 1,221 dev, and 1,140 test questions.

size.notes: JSONL files containing questions, ConceptNet target concepts, and 5 candidate choices.
